title: Restriction weight and random subset weight
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\delta\in\mathbb R$, let $J$ be a set of coordinates in $[n]$, and assign a sign in $\{\pm1\}$ to each coordinate outside $J$. The weight of the restriction that leaves $J$ free and fixes the remaining coordinates to those signs equals $\delta^{|J|}(1-\delta)^{n-|J|}$ divided by the number of sign assignments on the coordinates outside $J$.
